//: Calendar events. One shape for everything the calendar can mark: a holiday here, a myte birthday assembled at runtime by CalendarRegistry from the roster. Season names and season length live in SiteConfig.time — a date here is only ever a season name plus a 1-based day, or a weekday name.

holidays.name: Market Day
holidays.description: Traders set up on the green every week. Prices are kinder and the stock is stranger.

holidays.name: Flower Day
holidays.description: Everything in bloom at once. Mytes carry petals about and refuse to explain why.

holidays.name: The Long Sun
holidays.description: The year's brightest day. Nobody sleeps and nothing gets done.

holidays.name: Harvest Feast
holidays.description: The last big meal before the cold. Every bowl in the house is in use.

holidays.name: Starfall Eve
holidays.description: Lights in the windows, gifts left out overnight, and one very slow procession.
